name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with the engineering marvels of Soviet-era vehicles. While never a driver himself, he gravitated towards the technical aspects, spending countless hours tinkering with engines and absorbing schematics. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, which he then applied to a junior role at a local racing team.

Over the years, Dimitri's meticulous approach and keen eye for detail made him an invaluable asset. He possesses a natural talent for identifying potential issues before they become critical, earning him a reputation for reliability and problem-solving. At Cool Racing, he thrives in the fast-paced environment, focusing on ensuring that test drivers have the optimal conditions and resources to push the limits of the car. He believes in clear communication and collaborative problem-solving, making him a respected figure within the team. His innovative approaches to data analysis have helped the team identify previously unnoticed areas of improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Dimitri is of medium height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking only green tea during testing sessions.
